description: Fire Resilience of Physical Civil Infrastructure is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Erica Fischer, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). Fire threats are increasing across the US, stemming from both accidental structural fires and the increasing vulnerability and exposure of communities to wildfires. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-e29e-gv45. Keywords: fire,  wildfire, civil infrastructure, conference, research gaps. Published 2024-10-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
